# Ashton Li — Full Stack Developer

Full stack developer based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, building production web
applications with Laravel, Vue and MySQL. Open to remote software engineering
roles with international teams.

Primary stack: PHP, Laravel, Vue 3, TypeScript, MySQL, Docker.
Also works with: Python, Flutter, Tailwind CSS, Livewire, Linux.

## Pages

- [Portfolio home](https://ashton9404.vercel.app/): about, skills, experience, projects and contact
- [SunYad Corporate Website](https://ashton9404.vercel.app/projects/sunyad-corporate-website): production Laravel site with a client-operated CMS
- [Myson Corporate Website](https://ashton9404.vercel.app/projects/myson-corporate-website): production Laravel site with a customised rich-text publishing workflow
- [Stock Analysis Platform](https://ashton9404.vercel.app/projects/stock-analysis-platform): one Laravel API serving a Vue dashboard and a Flutter mobile app
- [Laravel Admin Starter](https://ashton9404.vercel.app/projects/laravel-admin-starter): open-source Laravel + Vue admin starter kit
